source.note: The factor names below were reconstructed into this repository by hand and have not been checked against OWASP's published AIVSS specification. Names, weights and the size of the factor set may all be wrong, and a missing factor changes every score this module produces. The arithmetic is exact and tested; the factor set is marked unverified throughout and every result repeats that.

factor_set.reason: OWASP's published factor list for AIVSS has not been fetched into this checkout, so this file cannot claim to hold all of it. A score computed over a partial factor set is provisional: it is comparable between two findings scored here and it is not comparable with a score produced by the published tool.

scale.note: Each factor is supplied as a fraction of its maximum, where 0 means the capability is absent from the affected system and 1 means it is present without restriction. The published scale was not verified, so this module defines its own and states it.

weighting.note: Every factor carries weight 1.0 because the published weights were not verified. Equal weighting is a stated choice rather than a claim about AIVSS. The arithmetic honours any weights placed here, so correcting them later changes scores without changing code.

autonomy_of_action.label: Autonomy of Action
autonomy_of_action.description: How far the system acts without a human approving each step.

tool_use.label: Tool Use
tool_use.description: Whether the system can invoke tools that change state outside the conversation.

memory_use.label: Memory Use
memory_use.description: Whether the system carries state between sessions that an attacker can write to.

dynamic_identity.label: Dynamic Identity
dynamic_identity.description: Whether the system can assume credentials or act as another principal.

multi_agent_interaction.label: Multi-Agent Interaction
multi_agent_interaction.description: Whether the system exchanges instructions with other agents that can relay an attack onward.

non_determinism.label: Non-Determinism
non_determinism.description: How far the same input can produce a different action, which makes a control unreliable rather than absent.

self_modification.label: Self-Modification
self_modification.description: Whether the system can change its own instructions, tools or configuration.

goal_driven_planning.label: Goal-Driven Planning
goal_driven_planning.description: Whether the system decomposes a goal into steps it selects itself, widening what a single injected instruction reaches.

composite.method: mean of the CVSS base score and the agentic risk sub-score
composite.note: The composite is the arithmetic mean of a CVSS base score supplied by the caller and the agentic sub-score computed here, then rounded up to one decimal. The shape was reconstructed rather than read from the specification. Rounding follows the CVSS Roundup function so the composite cannot disagree with the rounding of the base score it consumes.

severity_bands.note: Band edges follow the CVSS qualitative severity rating scale, which AIVSS composes with. They were not re-checked against the AIVSS specification.
